title: Identifier
description: Typed prefix plus lowercase Crockford Base32 payload (docs/03). Crockford Base32 omits I, L, O, U to avoid transcription ambiguity with 1 and 0.
x-invariants: Payload length is fixed at 26 characters (130 bits of entropy).
Prefix characters lie outside the payload alphabet, so a prefix can never be confused with payload data.
Identifiers are globally unique and are never reused after deletion.
Case is significant in the sense that the canonical form is lowercase; producers MUST NOT emit uppercase.
